en: Colored lithographic postcard showing a cobbled street lined with multi‑story historic buildings. Children and a few adults stand in the middle of the street. In the distance rise two tall church towers with onion‑shaped domes. A sign on the right reads "Foala Poporului." The captions at the bottom read "Hermannnstadt." and "Fleischergasse." A vertical imprint at the left margin credits the publisher and printer. The reverse side is blank except for printed Hungarian text "LEVELEZŐ-LAP" and standard address lines.
